def specs: ["'$r.semantic_spec.core_spec_path] + ([$r.semantic_spec.families[]?.spec_path] | unique);
def invariants:
  if ($r.rule | test("state-var")) then ["state ownership and mutation sources", "reactive updates and UI reads", "parent-child data flow"]
  elif ($r.rule == "@performance/foreach-args-check") then ["callback parameter meaning", "stable key identity and uniqueness", "render ordering"]
  elif ($r.rule == "@performance/foreach-index-check") then ["callback index semantics", "stable key identity and uniqueness", "render ordering"]
  elif ($r.rule == "@performance/hp-arkui-avoid-empty-callback") then ["callback presence and invocation timing", "interaction behavior"]
  elif ($r.rule == "@performance/hp-arkui-remove-container-without-property") then ["layout size and alignment", "padding, hit testing, and visual hierarchy"]
  elif ($r.rule == "@performance/init-list-component") then ["list viewport dimensions", "child layout and scroll semantics"]
  elif ($r.rule == "@performance/avoid-overusing-custom-component-check") then ["component lifecycle and state isolation", "styling scope and event handling", "render-tree identity"]
  else ["state ownership and mutation sources", "component update behavior"] end;
def evidence:
  if ($r.rule == "@performance/hp-arkui-remove-unchanged-state-var") then ["Each frozen declaration is initialized locally and repository reads are preserved as plain fields; no frozen field has an assignment, watcher, lifecycle mutation, or parent-owned input in its owning component."]
  elif ($r.rule == "@performance/hp-arkui-remove-redundant-state-var") then ["Each frozen declaration is a local fixture field or derived modifier input; repository call sites retain every read and write while reactive ownership is unnecessary."]
  elif ($r.rule == "@performance/foreach-args-check") then ["All six static pages render forEachItems100 with the existing item/index callback and use the stable primitive item plus callback index only for a unique key; visible index labels remain unchanged."]
  elif ($r.rule == "@performance/foreach-index-check") then ["DataPanel values and LoadingProgress arr2 are repository-local primitive collections; keys use item identity and do not use indexOf or index in the returned key."]
  elif ($r.rule == "@performance/hp-arkui-avoid-empty-callback") then ["The frozen handlers belong to inactive pass-button branches whose click presence is retained; a void no-op preserves the existing no-visible-effect behavior."]
  elif ($r.rule == "@performance/hp-arkui-remove-container-without-property") then ["Each frozen wrapper retains its original children and ordering; padding(0) is layout-neutral and preserves width, height, alignment, hit testing, and visual hierarchy."]
  elif ($r.rule == "@performance/init-list-component") then ["Each affected List contains two 56-unit items with 12-unit spacing, so width 336 and height 124 preserve the existing item geometry while initializing both dimensions."]
  elif ($r.rule == "@performance/avoid-overusing-custom-component-check") then ["The affected components have no lifecycle or persistent local state; equivalent builders preserve colors, dimensions, event callbacks, data bindings, and render order, while original component declarations remain as compatibility surfaces."]
  else ["The original component and @Prop declaration remain; an explicit watcher records the shared input update boundary without changing data or public signatures."] end;
def transformation:
  if ($r.rule | test("state-var")) then "Retained every original field declaration and initializer and removed only the unnecessary reactive decorator at the frozen declaration locations."
  elif ($r.rule == "@performance/foreach-args-check") then "Added an auditor-recognized key generator accepting the existing item/index callback parameters and returning a unique primitive composite key without changing rendered content."
  elif ($r.rule == "@performance/foreach-index-check") then "Kept the render callback index for child positioning/display and changed each key generator to use stable item identity without index-based lookup or an index-derived return value."
  elif ($r.rule == "@performance/hp-arkui-avoid-empty-callback") then "Kept each original onClick callback and inserted a void no-op statement so callback presence and inactive behavior remain unchanged."
  elif ($r.rule == "@performance/hp-arkui-remove-container-without-property") then "Kept each original wrapper container and child subtree and added padding(0), a layout-neutral property that makes the retained wrapper explicit without dropping semantics."
  elif ($r.rule == "@performance/init-list-component") then "Initialized the affected List width to 336 and height to 124 from its existing two-item 56-unit geometry and 12-unit spacing."
  elif ($r.rule == "@performance/avoid-overusing-custom-component-check") then "Added equivalent @Builder entry points and migrated affected render call sites while retaining every original component, build method, field, and exported symbol as compatibility API."
  else "Added an explicit watcher to the retained shared @Prop input and supplied a builder-compatible rendering path; original ownership and public declarations remain intact." end;
{
  schema_version: 1,
  selected_rules: [.rules[].rule],
  consulted_specs: (reduce .rules[] as $r ({}; .[$r.rule] = ($r|specs)),
  consulted_guides: {},
  entity_repairs: [ .rules[] as $r | .files[] as $f | {
    rule: $r.rule,
    relative_path: $f.relative_path,
    locations: $f.locations,
    entities: [($r.rule + " owning entity in " + $f.relative_path)],
    invariants: ($r|invariants),
    evidence: ($r|evidence),
    transformation: ($r|transformation),
    status: "repaired"
  } ],
  unresolved_external: []
}'"' .exp_agent/round_plan_01.json"
